artifact.export: Ultralytics 8.3.237, ONNX opset 17, 640x640, embedded COCO-80 vocabulary, no custom ingredient prompts

ingredient_benchmark.metric: macro F1 over exact label matches in the embedded COCO food subset only
observed_limitations: Detected broccoli and carrot on some relevant plates.
Also produced false food labels including sandwich, pizza, donut, cake, apple, banana, and orange.
The detector lacks the required ingredient vocabulary and has no ingredient normalization stage.

weight_benchmark.reason: YOLO-World v2 has no mass head and the public fixtures have no scale ground truth.

candidates.decision: Proves Android detector deployment only. Reject for the current ingredient UX; it needs a cleared ingredient vocabulary/model and a separate weighed-mass stage.

candidates.reason: The released research stack combines SAM, a food semantic segmenter, and a detector. No supported Android ONNX/LiteRT/Core ML artifact for the complete stack was supplied or found in this checkout.

The available project is a PyTorch/MMsegmentation semantic-segmentation benchmark. No Android-compatible artifact was supplied or found in this checkout; semantic masks alone do not yield repeated instances or grams.

overall_decision: Neither executed model proves ingredients plus grams. MobileSAM proves only prompted masks; COCO-vocabulary YOLO-World v2 has low exact visible-component F1. FoodSAM and FoodSeg103 remain offline research/teacher candidates until a converted artifact, compatible runtime, and legal/data review exist.
